title: Weasel — Parameter Sweep Analysis
description: Cumulative selection: generations-to-target vs length, charset size, offspring and mutation rate.

panels.title: Overview
panels.description: Row count, overall success rate and combination count for the selected batch.

targets.queryText:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Runs",
       ROUND(AVG(reached_target)*100,2) AS "Success %",
       COUNT(DISTINCT target_length||'/'||charset_size||'/'||offspring||'/'||mutation_rate) AS "Combos"
FROM runs WHERE batch_id = $batch;
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Runs",
       ROUND(AVG(reached_target)*100,2) AS "Success %",
       COUNT(DISTINCT target_length||'/'||charset_size||'/'||offspring||'/'||mutation_rate) AS "Combos"
FROM runs WHERE batch_id = $batch;

panels.title: Batches
panels.description: NULL finished_at means the batch was interrupted or failed.

targets.queryText:
SELECT id AS "Batch", COALESCE(label,'(none)') AS "Label",
       combos AS "Combos", runs_per_combo AS "Runs/combo", seed AS "Seed",
       CASE WHEN finished_at IS NULL THEN 'INTERRUPTED'
            ELSE ROUND((finished_at-started_at)/1000.0,1)||' s' END AS "Duration"
FROM batches ORDER BY id DESC;
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT id AS "Batch", COALESCE(label,'(none)') AS "Label",
       combos AS "Combos", runs_per_combo AS "Runs/combo", seed AS "Seed",
       CASE WHEN finished_at IS NULL THEN 'INTERRUPTED'
            ELSE ROUND((finished_at-started_at)/1000.0,1)||' s' END AS "Duration"
FROM batches ORDER BY id DESC;

panels.title: Sweep progress (runs completed)
panels.description: 10-second buckets. Updates live while a sweep runs (WAL mode). Widen the time range if empty.

targets.queryText:
SELECT (started_at/10000)*10000 AS time, COUNT(*) AS "runs"
FROM runs WHERE batch_id = $batch GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT (started_at/10000)*10000 AS time, COUNT(*) AS "runs"
FROM runs WHERE batch_id = $batch GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Success rate — offspring x mutation rate
panels.description: Fraction of runs reaching the target. The diagonal boundary is the error threshold.

targets.queryText:
SELECT offspring AS "n",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mutation_rate=0.01 THEN reached_target END),3) AS "0.01",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mutation_rate=0.02 THEN reached_target END),3) AS "0.02",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mutation_rate=0.03 THEN reached_target END),3) AS "0.03",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mutation_rate=0.04 THEN reached_target END),3) AS "0.04",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mutation_rate=0.05 THEN reached_target END),3) AS "0.05",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mutation_rate=0.07 THEN reached_target END),3) AS "0.07",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mutation_rate=0.1 THEN reached_target END),3) AS "0.1",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mutation_rate=0.13 THEN reached_target END),3) AS "0.13",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mutation_rate=0.16 THEN reached_target END),3) AS "0.16",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mutation_rate=0.2 THEN reached_target END),3) AS "0.2"
FROM runs WHERE batch_id = $batch AND charset_size = $k
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT offspring AS "n",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mutation_rate=0.01 THEN reached_target END),3) AS "0.01",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mutation_rate=0.02 THEN reached_target END),3) AS "0.02",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mutation_rate=0.03 THEN reached_target END),3) AS "0.03",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mutation_rate=0.04 THEN reached_target END),3) AS "0.04",

  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mutation_rate=0.13 THEN reached_target END),3) AS "0.13",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mutation_rate=0.16 THEN reached_target END),3) AS "0.16",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mutation_rate=0.2 THEN reached_target END),3) AS "0.2"
FROM runs WHERE batch_id = $batch AND charset_size = $k
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Mean generations — length x mutation rate (converged cells only)
panels.description: Blank cells are censored (not every run converged) and are excluded rather than shown misleadingly. The valley is the optimal mutation rate.

targets.queryText:
WITH ok AS (
  SELECT target_length, mutation_rate, 1 AS okflag
  FROM runs WHERE batch_id = $batch AND charset_size = $k AND offspring = $n
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING AVG(reached_target) = 1.0
)
SELECT r.target_length AS "L",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.01 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.01",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.02 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.02",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.03 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.03",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.04 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.04",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.05 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.05",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.07 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.07",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.1 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.1",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.13 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.13",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.16 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.16",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.2 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.2"
FROM runs r LEFT JOIN ok ON ok.target_length = r.target_length AND ok.mutation_rate = r.mutation_rate
WHERE r.batch_id = $batch AND r.charset_size = $k AND r.offspring = $n
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH ok AS (
  SELECT target_length, mutation_rate, 1 AS okflag
  FROM runs WHERE batch_id = $batch AND charset_size = $k AND offspring = $n
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING AVG(reached_target) = 1.0
)
SELECT r.target_length AS "L",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.01 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.01",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.02 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.02",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.03 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.03",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.04 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.04",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.05 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.05",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.07 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.07",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.1 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.1",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.13 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.13",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.16 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.16",
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.mutation_rate=0.2 AND ok.okflag=1 THEN r.generations END),1) AS "0.2"
FROM runs r LEFT JOIN ok ON ok.target_length = r.target_length AND ok.mutation_rate = r.mutation_rate
WHERE r.batch_id = $batch AND r.charset_size = $k AND r.offspring = $n
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Optimal mutation rate per length
panels.description: m x L stays near 1.2 at k=27 — roughly one mutation per copy.

targets.queryText:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT target_length L, mutation_rate m, AVG(generations) g
  FROM runs WHERE batch_id = $batch AND charset_size = $k AND offspring = $n
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING AVG(reached_target) = 1.0
)
SELECT L AS "L", m AS "best m", ROUND(m*L,2) AS "m x L", ROUND(g,1) AS "gens"
FROM c WHERE g = (SELECT MIN(g) FROM c c2 WHERE c2.L = c.L) ORDER BY L;
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT target_length L, mutation_rate m, AVG(generations) g
  FROM runs WHERE batch_id = $batch AND charset_size = $k AND offspring = $n
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING AVG(reached_target) = 1.0
)
SELECT L AS "L", m AS "best m", ROUND(m*L,2) AS "m x L", ROUND(g,1) AS "gens"
FROM c WHERE g = (SELECT MIN(g) FROM c c2 WHERE c2.L = c.L) ORDER BY L;

panels.title: Error threshold (highest m with >=99% success)
panels.description: Tolerable mutation load grows roughly with ln(n).

targets.queryText:
SELECT target_length AS "L",
  MAX(CASE WHEN offspring=5 THEN mutation_rate END) AS "n=5",
  MAX(CASE WHEN offspring=10 THEN mutation_rate END) AS "n=10",
  MAX(CASE WHEN offspring=25 THEN mutation_rate END) AS "n=25",
  MAX(CASE WHEN offspring=50 THEN mutation_rate END) AS "n=50",
  MAX(CASE WHEN offspring=100 THEN mutation_rate END) AS "n=100"
FROM (SELECT target_length, offspring, mutation_rate FROM runs
      WHERE batch_id = $batch AND charset_size = $k
      GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING AVG(reached_target) >= 0.99)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT target_length AS "L",
  MAX(CASE WHEN offspring=5 THEN mutation_rate END) AS "n=5",
  MAX(CASE WHEN offspring=10 THEN mutation_rate END) AS "n=10",
  MAX(CASE WHEN offspring=25 THEN mutation_rate END) AS "n=25",
  MAX(CASE WHEN offspring=50 THEN mutation_rate END) AS "n=50",
  MAX(CASE WHEN offspring=100 THEN mutation_rate END) AS "n=100"
FROM (SELECT target_length, offspring, mutation_rate FROM runs
      WHERE batch_id = $batch AND charset_size = $k
      GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING AVG(reached_target) >= 0.99)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Total evaluations vs offspring (each at its best m)
panels.description: Offspring x generations = total fitness evaluations. Minimises around n=25.

targets.queryText:
SELECT CAST(offspring AS TEXT) AS "n", MIN(w) AS "evaluations"
FROM (SELECT offspring, AVG(generations)*offspring w FROM runs
      WHERE batch_id = $batch AND target_length = $L AND charset_size = $k
      GROUP BY offspring, mutation_rate HAVING AVG(reached_target) = 1.0)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CAST("n" AS INTEGER);
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(offspring AS TEXT) AS "n", MIN(w) AS "evaluations"
FROM (SELECT offspring, AVG(generations)*offspring w FROM runs
      WHERE batch_id = $batch AND target_length = $L AND charset_size = $k
      GROUP BY offspring, mutation_rate HAVING AVG(reached_target) = 1.0)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CAST("n" AS INTEGER);

panels.title: Generations distribution (one cell)
panels.description: Raw per-run generation counts for the selected L/k/n/m. Right-skewed near the threshold.

panels.title: Regressions vs mutation rate
panels.description: Fitness drops (parent does not compete). Zero in the safe regime, then explodes — a sharp threshold detector.

panels.title: Generations vs target length
panels.description: Each n at its own best m. Switch to an XY chart with log axes to see the L^1.26 power law as a straight line.

targets.queryText:
SELECT CAST(target_length AS TEXT) AS "L",
  MIN(CASE WHEN offspring=5 THEN g END) AS "n=5",
  MIN(CASE WHEN offspring=25 THEN g END) AS "n=25",
  MIN(CASE WHEN offspring=100 THEN g END) AS "n=100"
FROM (SELECT target_length, offspring, AVG(generations) g FROM runs
      WHERE batch_id = $batch AND charset_size = $k
      GROUP BY 1,2,mutation_rate HAVING AVG(reached_target) = 1.0)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CAST("L" AS INTEGER);
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(target_length AS TEXT) AS "L",
  MIN(CASE WHEN offspring=5 THEN g END) AS "n=5",
  MIN(CASE WHEN offspring=25 THEN g END) AS "n=25",
  MIN(CASE WHEN offspring=100 THEN g END) AS "n=100"
FROM (SELECT target_length, offspring, AVG(generations) g FROM runs
      WHERE batch_id = $batch AND charset_size = $k
      GROUP BY 1,2,mutation_rate HAVING AVG(reached_target) = 1.0)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CAST("L" AS INTEGER);

panels.title: Slowest fully-converged combinations
panels.description: Only cells where all runs converged, so the mean is trustworthy.

targets.queryText:
SELECT target_length AS "L", charset_size AS "k", offspring AS "n", mutation_rate AS "m",
       ROUND(AVG(generations),1) AS "avg gens", MAX(generations) AS "worst"
FROM runs WHERE batch_id = $batch
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 HAVING AVG(reached_target) = 1.0
ORDER BY AVG(generations) DESC LIMIT 20;
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT target_length AS "L", charset_size AS "k", offspring AS "n", mutation_rate AS "m",
       ROUND(AVG(generations),1) AS "avg gens", MAX(generations) AS "worst"
FROM runs WHERE batch_id = $batch
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 HAVING AVG(reached_target) = 1.0
ORDER BY AVG(generations) DESC LIMIT 20;
